links.outcome: Reader performance with versus without AI-CAD: BI-RADS-like 3 calls, agreement, lesion detection
links.effect: AI-augmented reading reduced BI-RADS-like 3 calls by 29% (P=.019), raised interrater agreement (0.57 vs 0.49), preserved accuracy; two of three readers detected more malignant lesions (63/69 vs 59/69; 64/69 vs 62/69).
links.quote: The AI-augmented approach significantly reduced BI-RADS-like 3 calls in breast DWI by 29% (P =.019) and increased interrater agreement (0.57 ± 0.10 vs 0.49 ± 0.11), while preserving diagnostic accuracy.

screen.reason: Empirical multireader study evaluating the clinical workflow effect of an AI-powered CAD system (AI-assisted vs manual interpretation) on diagnostic accuracy, inter-rater agreement, and workload reduction in breast DWI.
